title: NBA Teams With the Most Finals Lost - LandOfBasketball.com
snippet: Which team has lost the most NBA Finals? The Los Angeles Lakers are the team with the most Finals lost in NBA history with 15 losses in the Championship series. That means that they have been the team that lost in 18.8% of a total of 80 NBA Finals. On the positive side the Lakers have been present in 32 NBA Finals and have won the title 17 times.

title: NBA Finals - Wikipedia
snippet: The NBA Finals is the annual championship series of the National Basketball Association (NBA). The Eastern and Western Conference champions play a best-of-seven series to determine the league champion. title: Worst NBA Teams To Make The NBA Finals - Champs or Chumps
snippet: Who is the worst team to make the NBA Finals? Based on regular season winning percentage, the 1959 Minneapolis Lakers were the worst team to make the NBA Finals. They finished the regular season with only a 33-39 record, but made the Finals where they lost to the Boston Celtics.
